paragraphs.source_en: Then a hermit, who visited the city once a year, came forth and said, Speak to us of **Pleasure**.

paragraphs.source_en: And I fain would have you sing it with fullness of heart; yet I would not have you lose your hearts in the singing.

paragraphs.source_en: Some of your youth seek pleasure as if it were all, and they are judged and rebuked. I would not judge nor rebuke them. I would have them seek.
